title: Combobox
summary: Editable combobox: type to filter a list of options.

examples.label: Filter and pick
examples.subject: component:combobox
examples.markup: <ui-combobox label="Country" name="country" placeholder="Search…"><ui-option value="ca">Canada</ui-option><ui-option value="fi">Finland</ui-option><ui-option value="jp">Japan</ui-option><ui-option value="no">Norway</ui-option></ui-combobox>

examples.label: Multiple, with chips
examples.subject: component:combobox
examples.markup: <ui-combobox label="Labels" multiple value="bug,docs"><ui-option value="bug">Bug</ui-option><ui-option value="docs">Docs</ui-option><ui-option value="ui">UI</ui-option><ui-option value="perf">Performance</ui-option></ui-combobox>
examples.note: Each value is a chip; Backspace in the empty input removes the last one.
